title: Djezzy SOC Platform - Content Security Policy Configuration
description: CSP headers for Next.js application with ANRT compliance requirements

Content-Security-Policy.value: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self' 'nonce-{nonce}' 'strict-dynamic' https:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob: https://*.djezzy.dz https://*.corporate.djezzy.dz; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' wss: https://api.djezzy-soc.dz https://siem-backend.djezzy-soc.svc.cluster.local; frame-ancestors 'none'; frame-src 'self'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; object-src 'none'; manifest-src 'self'; worker-src 'self' blob:; media-src 'self' blob: data:; upgrade-insecure-requests

default-src.rationale: Deny all by default - whitelist approach for maximum security

script-src.rationale: Allow only self scripts with nonce-based CSP, strict-dynamic for modern browsers, fallback to HTTPS for legacy support

style-src.rationale: Required for Tailwind CSS and component styling. Consider migrating to nonce-based styles in future.

img-src.rationale: Allow images from Djezzy domains only plus data URIs for inline charts/graphs

font-src.rationale: Self-hosted fonts only, no external CDN dependencies

connect-src.rationale: Restrict API calls to SOC backend services only via secure WebSocket/HTTPS

frame-ancestors.rationale: Prevent clickjacking attacks - critical for SOC dashboard

frame-src.rationale: Allow iframes from same origin only (e.g., embedded reports)

form-action.rationale: Forms can only submit to same origin

object-src.rationale: Block Flash, Java applets, and other plugins entirely

worker-src.rationale: Web Workers from same origin or blob URLs for processing

media-src.rationale: Audio/video for alert sounds and threat visualizations

upgrade-insecure-requests.rationale: Force HTTPS for all requests - mandatory per ANRT

Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only.value: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self' 'nonce-{nonce}' 'strict-dynamic' https: 'report-sample'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'report-sample'; img-src 'self' data: blob: https://*.djezzy.dz https://*.corporate.djezzy.dz; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' wss: https://api.djezzy-soc.dz https://siem-backend.djezzy-soc.svc.cluster.local; frame-ancestors 'none'; frame-src 'self'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; object-src 'none'; report-uri /api/security/csp-report

Strict-Transport-Security.rationale: HSTS with 1-year max age, subdomain coverage, and browser preload list inclusion

X-XSS-Protection.rationale: Disable XSS Auditor (deprecated) - rely on CSP instead

Referrer-Policy.rationale: Send full referrer to same origin, origin-only cross-origin

Permissions-Policy.value: accelerometer=(), camera=(), geolocation=(), gyroscope=(), magnetometer=(), microphone=(), payment=(), usb=(), screen-wake-lock=(self), display-capture=(self)
Permissions-Policy.rationale: Block all sensitive permissions except those needed for SOC operations

Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy.rationale: Isolate browsing context for cross-origin attacks

Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy.rationale: Require Cross-Origin Resource Policy headers on cross-origin resources

Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy.rationale: Resources accessible by same-site requests only

Cache-Control.sensitive: private, max-age=0, no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate, proxy-revalidate

testing.devOverrideWarning: NEVER disable CSP in production - this is a security violation subject to disciplinary action
